name: pink-velvet-gothic-girls
image_purpose: group fashion campaign and editorial visual

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic overhead gothic fashion editorial featuring three adult women on a textured pink faux-fur surface.
prompt.main_subject: Three adult women with original fictional identities and pale editorial makeup lie in a triangular composition. The top subject has long blonde waves, a black velvet corset, opera gloves, and a crystal choker; the middle subject has long straight black hair, a black leather fashion bustier with a structured mesh panel, and a crystal collar; the foreground subject has long wavy black hair, a black brocade corset with lace trim, opera gloves, a black satin skirt, and a crystal choker.
prompt.composition_elements: Direct 90-degree overhead view, tight frame filled by the trio and bright pink plush texture, all faces angled toward camera, arms creating leading lines, high contrast between black styling, pale skin, and pink background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft overhead beauty-dish or softbox lighting with even facial illumination, controlled specular highlights on leather and velvet, polished dark-coquette atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm lens look, f/5.6, 1/125s, ISO 100, sharp focus across all three faces, photorealistic skin, fabric and jewelry detail, natural anatomy.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic overhead gothic fashion editorial of three adult women with original fictional identities lying in a triangular composition on a bright pink plush faux-fur surface.
